attractions.name: Palm Jumeirah Monorail
attractions.description: Scenic monorail ride with elevated views of Palm Jumeirah, a man-made island known for luxury resorts, upscale residences and landmarks like Atlantis The Palm and The View at The Palm.
attractions.hours: Monday to Thursday: 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM (last entry 9:00 PM); Friday to Sunday: 9:00 AM – 12:00 AM (last entry 11:00 PM)
tips: Start from Atlantis The Palm, the final stop
Buy the Monorail Day Pass with unlimited rides on the same day
attractions._source_file: Dubai and Abu Dhabi - UAE/Shivani and Saurabh_Abu Dhabi and Dubai-All inclusive guide(1).docx

attractions.name: Atlantis The Palm
attractions.description: Landmark resort featuring the iconic Atlantis Hotel; the final monorail stop.
attractions._source_file: Dubai and Abu Dhabi - UAE/Shivani and Saurabh_Abu Dhabi and Dubai-All inclusive guide(1).docx

attractions.name: The View at The Palm
attractions.description: Observation spot with panoramic vistas of the island and Dubai skyline, accessed from Nakheel Mall Station.
tips: Nakheel Mall Station also gives access to The Palm Tower, St. Regis Dubai and Club Vista Mare
attractions._source_file: Dubai and Abu Dhabi - UAE/Shivani and Saurabh_Abu Dhabi and Dubai-All inclusive guide(1).docx

attractions.name: Palm West Beach
attractions.description: Beach area ideal for swimming, dining and relaxing by the sea, accessed from Al Ittihad Station; the station also connects to Golden Mile Galleria for premium shopping.
